# Marsilea

> Marsilea is a Python library for building composable visualizations declaratively on top of
> Matplotlib. You start from a main plot — a heatmap, a bar chart, an UpSet plot — and add side
> plots, labels, dendrograms and legends to any of its four sides with `add_top`, `add_bottom`,
> `add_left`, `add_right`. It covers figures that are otherwise hand-assembled with GridSpec:
> complex annotated heatmaps (the R ComplexHeatmap equivalent), oncoprints, UpSet plots,
> sequence logos, sequence alignments, genome tracks and single-cell panels.

Install: `pip install marsilea` or `conda install -c conda-forge marsilea`.
Requires Python >= 3.11. Optional extras: `marsilea[fast]` (fastcluster), `marsilea[stats]`
(statannotations, for significance annotation).

## Quickstart

```python
import numpy as np
import marsilea as ma
import marsilea.plotter as mp

data = np.random.default_rng(0).standard_normal((10, 10))

h = ma.Heatmap(data, linewidth=0.5, height=4, width=4)
h.add_top(mp.Bar(data.mean(axis=0)), size=0.8, pad=0.1)
h.add_left(mp.Labels([f"Gene{i}" for i in range(10)]), pad=0.05)
h.add_dendrogram("right")
h.add_legends()
h.render()
```

Every `add_*` call takes a plotter, a `size` in inches and a `pad`. Nothing is drawn until
`render()`; `save("figure.png")` renders and writes in one step. `group_rows`/`group_cols`
split the canvas into labelled chunks; `cut_rows`/`cut_cols` split it at given positions.

## Core API

- Canvases: `ma.Heatmap`, `ma.SizedHeatmap`, `ma.CatHeatmap`, `ma.Upset`, `ma.WhiteBoard`
  (start from an empty canvas), `ma.ClusterBoard`, `ma.StackBoard`, `ma.CompositeBoard`.
- Plotters (`import marsilea.plotter as mp`): `Bar`, `StackBar`, `CenterBar`, `Numbers`, `Box`,
  `Boxen`, `Violin`, `Point`, `Strip`, `Swarm`, `Area`, `Range`, `Arc`, `ColorMesh`, `SizedMesh`,
  `MarkerMesh`, `TextMesh`, `Colors`, `Labels`, `AnnoLabels`, `Chunk`, `FixedChunk`, `Title`,
  `Image`, `Emoji`, `SeqLogo`.
- Board methods: `add_top`, `add_bottom`, `add_left`, `add_right`, `add_dendrogram`, `add_title`,
  `add_legends`, `group_rows`, `group_cols`, `cut_rows`, `cut_cols`, `render`, `save`.
- Data: `ma.load_data("<name>")` loads the datasets used across the examples;
  `ma.UpsetData.from_memberships(...)` / `.from_sets(...)` prepare UpSet input.
- Custom plotters: subclass `mp.RenderPlan` and implement `render_ax`.

## Documentation

- [Tutorial](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/index.html): the guided path, start here.
- [Introduction](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/intro.html): the composable model, sides and units.
- [Heatmap tutorial](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/heatmap.html): clustering, grouping and annotating a heatmap.
- [Concatenation](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/concatenation.html): placing several canvases in one figure.
- [Stacking](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/stack.html): layering plotters in a single axes.
- [UpSet tutorial](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/upset.html): set intersections from memberships or sets.
- [Significance annotation](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/stats_annotation.html): p-value brackets on seaborn plotters.
- [Custom plotters](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/new_renderplan.html): writing your own `RenderPlan`.
- [Axes-level API](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/axes-level.html): using plotters on plain Matplotlib axes.
- [How-to guides](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/how_to/index.html): layout, dendrograms, legends, styling, saving.
- [API reference](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/index.html): every class and parameter.
- [Gallery](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/index.html): all examples with runnable source.
- [Installation](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/installation.html)

## Plot types (example with full source)

- [Heatmap](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Basics/plot_heatmap.html): the minimal heatmap.
- [Complex annotated heatmap](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Basics/plot_adv_heatmap.html): grouped rows and columns, annotations on every side.
- [Two heatmaps side by side](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Basics/plot_two_heatmap.html): concatenating canvases.
- [Stacked bar chart](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Basics/plot_stacked_bar.html): `StackBar` with annotations.
- [Oncoprint](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_oncoprint.html): TCGA breast cancer mutations, via the bundled `oncoprinter.OncoPrint`.
- [UpSet plot](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_upset.html): genre intersections in the IMDB top 1000 movies.
- [Sequence logo](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Plotters/plot_seq_logo.html): `SeqLogo` from a position frequency matrix.
- [Sequence alignment (MSA)](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_seqalign.html): alignment with logo and conservation track.
- [Single-cell RNA-seq heatmap](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_pbmc3k.html): marker genes across PBMC 3k cell types.
- [Single-cell multi-omics](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_sc_multiomics.html): RNA, protein and chromatin views in one figure.
- [Genome track plot](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_tracks.html): stacked signal tracks.
- [Arc diagram](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_arc_diagram.html): the Les Misérables character network.
- [Bivariate distribution](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_bivariate_dist.html): joint plot with marginals.
- [Spatial map annotation](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_mouse_embryo.html): annotating a mouse embryo map.
- [Significance annotation](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_stats_annotation.html): p-value brackets on box plots.
- [Bar chart with images](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_tiobe_index.html): TIOBE index with language logos.
- [Cross-layout stacked bars](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_oil_well.html): fat content in cooking oils.
- [All plotters at a glance](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/Gallery/plot_available_plotters.html)

## For AI assistants

- [Use Marsilea with AI assistants](https://marsilea.readthedocs.io/en/stable/ai_assistants.html): setup for Claude Code and other assistants.
- Claude Code skill, installed from inside Claude Code:
  `/plugin marketplace add Marsilea-viz/marsilea-skill` then
  `/plugin install marsilea@marsilea-marketplace`. Source:
  [marsilea-skill](https://github.com/Marsilea-viz/marsilea-skill).
- Marsilea is also documented in scanpy:
  [Plotting with Marsilea](https://scanpy.scverse.org/en/stable/how-to/plotting-with-marsilea.html).

- [Source code](https://github.com/Marsilea-viz/marsilea)
- [legendkit](https://legendkit.readthedocs.io/en/stable/): the legend library Marsilea uses.
- [mpl-fontkit](https://github.com/Marsilea-viz/mpl-fontkit/): font management used in the examples.

  for composable visualizations." *Genome Biology* 26, 5 (2025).
